summary: test_2119_skills_publish_spec_and_review_material asserts exact-text equality of each built-in workflow's real review-skill instructions against a hand-typed golden string containing the 'Frame the section explicitly as recommendations for the user to react to ... at the PR approval gate' sentence; monkeypatching that sentence out of the production _DEFERRED_ISSUES_TRIAGE_INSTRUCTIONS (no mocks, real discover_workflows) made the test fail as expected, confirming genuine coverage.
